message.content: Camp Nou’s official design capacity once topped out at **about 99,300 spectators**—the largest football ground in Europe when it opened in 1957. After subsequent refurbishments, safety upgrades, and changes in standing‑area rules, its practical, seated capacity today sits closer to **≈ 93–95 thousand** depending on configuration.
